mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.15% compresses the risk-free rate component of equity discount models, increasing present values of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST > 850) and real sales (RSAFS > 420000) above thresholds indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive equity valuations and 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 850 and RSAFS > 420000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, industrial production growth (INDPRO > 98.5) signals sustained manufacturing output, supporting positive equity returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with INDPRO > 98.5.

mechanism_narrative: Positive housing starts (HOUST > 0) indicate robust consumer demand for new homes, correlating with strong economic activity and positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 0.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 230 signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: Stagnant employment growth (PAYEMS < 136000) combined with elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5) indicates weak labor market conditions suppressing consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS < 136000 and UNRATE > 7.5.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary easing cycles, declining FEDFUNDS reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as monetary easing cycles with FEDFUNDS < 0.15%.
